name: reconciliation_daily
description: Stawi §10.3 reconciliation_daily. Once per UTC day: RunReconciliation checks P7 over every (asset, value_location) and records PLATFORM_OUTAGE / RAIL_OUTAGE causes from executor heartbeat gaps (§6.4); an unresolved difference blocks limit raises (P7, enforced by finance's LimitService, not here). Then AnchorDay computes the roots and builds the AUDIT_ANCHOR intent (§10.7); the anchor is overdue after anchor_overdue_seconds (D-Q9, pinned). This process never approves a difference and never re-anchors on its own.

input.constitution_hash: bytes32-hex (protocol scope: the protocol policy's hash; room_id empty)
input.day_close_lag_seconds: uint64 (pinned: distance from the schedule fire time back into the closed UTC day)
input.anchor_overdue_seconds: uint64 (D-Q9 36 h, pinned from the protocol policy)

config.schedule_note: schedule.fired payload = {schedule_id, schedule_name, fired_at, input}; pinned parameters therefore live under payload.input.* and are set by finance's setup step when it registers the schedule (re-registered on each protocol policy activation).

steps.name: RUNNING — P7: derive the closed UTC day from fired_at and run reconciliation over every (asset, value_location)
closed day = fired_at − day_close_lag (pinned) as zero-padded year/month/dom (trustage CEL has no format_time and rejects string concatenation over dyn values, so the parts are composed by template)

steps.name: EXCEPTIONS — P7: differences are open ReconciliationDifference records (reason_code, owner, evidence) awaiting human approval; limit raises are blocked by finance. Record the fact; still anchor the day (§10.7 anchors facts, not cleanliness).

input.message: reconciliation differences open; limit raises blocked by finance (P7)

steps.name: ANCHORING — §10.7: AnchorDay computes the day's roots and builds the AUDIT_ANCHOR intent (anchor key held by settlement, §5.5)
ANCHOR_PENDING — §10.7 / D-Q9: wait for the anchor intent's finality; overdue after anchor_overdue_seconds (pinned). finance emits ledger.anchor_overdue; this process only records.
ANCHORED (terminal) — §10.1 ledger.anchored; offline verification possible from the anchored roots
ANCHOR_FAILED (terminal) — the anchor intent FAILED; re-anchoring is a new intent built by the next run or an operator; nothing forced

input.message: anchor intent failed; no retry forced

steps.name: ANCHOR_OVERDUE (terminal) — D-Q9: no finality within 36 h; ledger.anchor_overdue is finance's fact; limit raises stay blocked (§5.3)
HALTED (terminal) — §10.3: unexpected domain state; record and stop

input.message: process halted: unexpected domain state; no transition forced

steps.name: STALLED (terminal) — §10.3: RPC fault after retries; record and stop; the next scheduled run covers the day again idempotently

input.message: process stalled: process command failed after retries; no transition forced
